_comment: Blocks that are a sketch rather than a program, and why. They live here
rather than in a marker on the page because Mintlify renders anything in a
fence info string as a visible filename badge, and an HTML comment breaks
its MDX parser. Each entry names the page and a distinctive substring of
the block's code, so the entry survives the block moving up or down.
Adding one is a deliberate act: it means nobody can run that block, so it
needs a reason a reader would accept.
